gameplay.movement: one cardinal grid cell per action; reject walls and out-of-bounds moves
gameplay.before_key: exit tile is blocked until key is collected
constraints: All coordinates in bounds; walls and three entities do not overlap.
Player can reach key, then exit through non-wall cells; pre-key path must not require entering exit.
gameplay.coordinates: [x,y], origin top-left, x right, y down

art.medium: Generated SVG vector assets, 32 by 32 viewBox; no external raster generation needed for this small vector example.

manifest_format.assets: object mapping each required asset ID to a project-relative SVG file path

runtime.controls: arrow keys or WASD; restart control
runtime.observable: key possession and win status are visible; all five asset types are used
runtime.offline: no network fetch, accounts, third-party libraries or online service required
